newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt to start trade tour to Asia on Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Egypt to start trade tour to Asia on Sunday.

text.p: An Egyptian government delegation will visit Asia this week on a tour to promote trade and investment, and proposed projects include a free zone for the Mediterranean, Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri said on Saturday.
Ganzouri, five ministers and Egyptian businessmen will leave on Sunday for the ten-day tour to Malaysia, Singapore and China.

"We will sign four accords with Singapore, and five with each of Malaysia and China," Ganzouri told reporters. "A large project will be presented to Malaysia to set up a free trade zone east of the Suez Canal, looking at the Mediterranean."

The government newpaper Al-Ahram on Saturday reported Egypt's exports to China were $13.1 million and imports $439.6 million in 1995. Exports to Malaysia were $11.3 million, while imports were $272.12 million.
